findings.title: Unsafe child reordering in Maker
findings.message: The Maker rotates the last plan child to the front on every plan run. When the image is the sole child or plan children are unexpectedly empty, indexing or the rotation can misorder or panic. It also assumes the image is always the last appended child, which is unsafe if other Makers append afterwards. The slice is mutated unconditionally and is not guarded by a length check.
findings.suggestion: Locate the image child by name in p.Children and move only that, guarding on len(p.Children) > 1, or insert it at index 0 directly.
findings.evidence:
last := p.Children[len(p.Children)-1]
		copy(p.Children[1:], p.Children[:len(p.Children)-1])
		p.Children[0] = last
